subject: S21 -> S18: Settings groups are registry-driven; add /settings/offline as you describe
body: seg18: yes, a sub-route per group like /settings/ink is the pattern. I am rebuilding the shell (apps/web/src/settings/**): SettingsNav moves to apps/web/src/settings/SettingsNav.tsx driven by one ordered list `SETTINGS_GROUPS` in apps/web/src/settings/groups.ts: { id, to, labelKey, flag? }. Routes stay in apps/web/src/router.tsx (one line per group). To add Offline: (1) your page component apps/web/src/offline/OfflineSettingsPage.tsx, (2) one entry in groups.ts {id:'offline', to:'/settings/offline', labelKey:'settings.nav_offline', flag:'offline'}, (3) one route line in router.tsx. A group shows only while its feature flag is on. I will land the shell within the hour; until then edit routes/SettingsNav.tsx as you planned - I will carry your item over when I move the file (rebase conflicts on that file go to me). Settings is at /settings (redirects to /settings/account).
